From 78d23a3263376611d7b065944fd7a5597bec025c Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Adam Retter <adam.retter@googlemail.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Jun 2016 15:59:22 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] [bugfix] exist.home is not in
 src/org/exist/system.properties. Fixes a bug introduced in 3dc5041


diff --git a/src/org/exist/jetty/JettyStart.java b/src/org/exist/jetty/JettyStart.java
index cf0e63034d..8948776320 100644
--- a/src/org/exist/jetty/JettyStart.java
+++ b/src/org/exist/jetty/JettyStart.java
@@ -129,13 +129,12 @@ public class JettyStart extends Observable implements LifeCycle.Listener {
 
         logger.info("Running as user '" 
                 + System.getProperty("user.name", "(unknown user.name)") + "'");
-
+        logger.info("[eXist Home : "
+                + System.getProperty("exist.home", "unknown") + "]");
         logger.info("[eXist Version : " 
                 + SystemProperties.getInstance().getSystemProperty("product-version", "unknown") + "]");
         logger.info("[eXist Build : " 
                 + SystemProperties.getInstance().getSystemProperty("product-build", "unknown") + "]");
-        logger.info("[eXist Home : " 
-                + SystemProperties.getInstance().getSystemProperty("exist.home", "unknown") + "]");
         logger.info("[Git commmit : " 
                 + SystemProperties.getInstance().getSystemProperty("git-commit", "unknown") + "]");
         
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `src/org/exist/jetty/JettyStart.java`**
   - Removed the line that logs the eXist Home directory using `SystemProperties.getInstance().getSystemProperty("exist.home", "unknown")`.
   - Added a new line that logs the eXist Home directory using `System.getProperty("exist.home", "unknown")`.

### Relationships Between Modifications
The modification in `JettyStart.java` replaces the method of retrieving the eXist Home directory from the system properties. The previous implementation used the `SystemProperties` class to fetch the property, which was likely causing the bug. The new implementation directly uses `System.getProperty`, ensuring that the correct value is logged and addressing the bug introduced in a previous commit (3dc5041). This change improves the reliability of the logging related to the eXist Home directory.
